types.label: Global Standard
types.tip: Pay per token. Requests can be processed in any Azure region worldwide. Highest default quota — the best place to start.

types.label: Data Zone Standard
types.tip: Pay per token. Processing stays inside the Microsoft-defined data zone (US or EU).

types.label: Regional Standard
types.tip: Pay per token. Processing stays in the region you deploy to.

types.label: Global Provisioned (PTU)
types.tip: Reserved throughput (PTUs) billed hourly or via reservation. Processing can happen in any Azure region.

types.label: Data Zone Provisioned (PTU)
types.tip: Reserved throughput (PTUs) with processing kept inside the data zone (US or EU).

types.label: Regional Provisioned (PTU)
types.tip: Reserved throughput (PTUs) with processing kept in the deployment region.

types.label: Batch
types.tip: Asynchronous jobs with a 24-hour target turnaround at a lower price than Standard.

types.label: Partner / Marketplace
types.tip: Partner model deployed as a serverless API, typically billed through Azure Marketplace.

types.label: Listed (type not published)
types.tip: Microsoft lists the model in this region but the deployment type is not broken out.

soon.label: Retiring within 30 days
soon.title: Retiring within 30 days
soon.body: This version is switched off on its retirement date; after that every request returns 410 Gone. Standard deployments may be auto-upgraded to the replacement — provisioned (PTU) deployments are not.
soon.action: Move traffic to the replacement now.

retiring.label: Retiring within 90 days
retiring.title: Retiring within 90 days
retiring.body: A firm retirement date is less than three months away. Existing deployments keep working until then. PTU deployments must be migrated by hand.
retiring.action: Test the replacement and plan the cut-over.

pending.label: Retirement imminent
pending.title: Retirement imminent
pending.body: Microsoft said this version retires no earlier than a date that has now passed, so it can be switched off at any time once notice is given.
pending.action: Treat it as retiring now — migrate.

deprecated.label: Deprecated
deprecated.title: Deprecated
deprecated.body: No longer available to new customers. Subscriptions that already deployed this version can keep creating and managing deployments until it retires.
deprecated.action: Don't start new work on it; schedule a migration before retirement.

preview.label: Preview
preview.title: Preview
preview.body: Experimental: weights, runtime and API might change and it is not guaranteed to reach GA. When it retires it is force-upgraded or removed with at least 30 days notice.
preview.action: Great for evaluation — avoid for critical production.

ga.label: Generally available
ga.title: Generally available
ga.body: Production-ready: weights and APIs are fixed and new deployments are allowed. Most GA models get about 18 months before retirement (12 for some partner models).
ga.action: Safe to build on — note the retirement date in your roadmap.

retired.label: Retired
retired.title: Retired
retired.body: Removed from service. All inference requests return 410 Gone.

untracked.label: No retirement date
untracked.title: No retirement date published
untracked.body: Microsoft's retirement tables don't list a date for this model yet (common for new and partner models).
untracked.action: Check the model card in Foundry before committing long-term.
